scope: Local academic prototype in Moldova, assumed from course context.
status: Public redistribution and deployment clearance NOT established.

ISOT.finding: Public academic download and requested citations; no explicit general redistribution license established.

FakeNewsNet.finding: Authors restrict full corpus distribution for publisher copyright and Twitter policies; repository LICENSE endpoint returned 404. Public minimal CSV availability is not a blanket copyright license.

primary_legal_sources.finding: Official AGEPI reference to Moldova copyright law 230/2022. Research use and redistribution must be assessed separately.
CNPDCP guidance states law 195/2024 is in force from 23 August 2026; purpose limitation, minimization and retention apply where personal data is processed.

implemented_controls: Raw corpora remain in ignored local data folders; no publisher crawling or tweet hydration.
No external personal profiles, sensitive attributes or person-level risk scoring.
New persistent stream logs redact article titles and body text by default.
Statistical reports export article IDs and aggregate results instead of raw article text.
Automatic public verdict/release gate disabled when external evidence fails.
unresolved: Explicit dataset redistribution rights and intended public deployment jurisdiction.
Names and other personal data may remain in source news; no claim of complete anonymization.
Existing local v1 logs, if any, predate the new minimization rule and require owner retention review.
A rights-holder/institution review is required for redistribution; this is an issue inventory, not legal certification.
